class Event {
  t1:Real

  duration:Real
  success:Bool

  req t1 >= 0

  req t2 > t1

  req t2 = t1 + duration

  req duration > 0

  fun before(e:Event) : Bool
  {
    t2 < e.t1
  }

  fun meets(e:Event) : Bool
  {
    t2 = e.t1
  }

  fun overlaps(e:Event) : Bool
  {
    t2 > e.t1 && t2 < e.t2
  }

  fun starts(e:Event) : Bool
  {
    t1 = e.t1
  }

  fun during(e:Event) : Bool
  {
    t2 > e.t1 && t2 < e.t2 && t1 > e.t1 && t2 < e.t2
  }

  fun finishes(e:Event) : Bool
  {
    t2 = e.t2
  }

  fun equal(e:Event) : Bool
  {
    t1 = e.t1 && t2 = e.t2
  }
}
